title: Magnitude 7.7 Earthquake – 68 km NNW of Ende, Indonesia
summary: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck 68 km north-northwest of Ende, Indonesia, as reported by the USGS. The event received significant attention with 183 points and 43 comments on Hacker News, indicating public interest in natural disaster events.
problem_solved: Provides real-time seismic event reporting and public safety information about a major earthquake in Indonesia.
why_valuable: Offers critical earthquake data for emergency response, public awareness, and scientific monitoring of seismic activity in the region.
